name: manual_fd1652
claim: A compatibility flag that defaults to the legacy, less safe behaviour needs a structural guard, not a comment: an AST scan test that fails when product code builds the object without the explicit safe value, a documented precondition to flip the default before serving, and mutation checks of the scan itself.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: the governed mode of the consumer store defaulted to off so 150 slice-1 tests and the byte-identical interop probe kept working; a side review noted a forgotten flag would silently skip the reservation check.
